name: Brat summer
blurb: Charli XCX's 2024 album Brat turned into a lime-green, messy, party-girl summer mood
title: Brat Summer Meaning: What Charli XCX's Brat Trend Is
description: Brat summer is the 2024 trend inspired by Charli XCX's album Brat: lime green, a little messy, confident and fun. Collins made "brat" its 2024 Word of the Year.
answer: Brat summer is the 2024 pop-culture trend inspired by Charli XCX's album Brat, released on 7 June 2024. Being "brat" means being a bit messy, loud and carefree but confident about it; Charli described a brat as a girl who is a little messy, likes to party and maybe says some dumb things sometimes. The album's lime-green cover, the "Apple" dance on TikTok and endless brat-style edits made it the mood of the summer, and Collins Dictionary named "brat" its 2024 Word of the Year.

body: Brat is an attitude rather than a look: honest, a little chaotic, unbothered by being perfect. Collins defines it as "characterized by a confident, independent, and hedonistic attitude". Visually, Brat summer means the album's cover, a flat lime-green square with the lowercase word "brat" in a plain, slightly blurry font, plus party-girl styling like white tank tops, sunglasses and smudged eyeliner.

body.note: A fan-made "brat generator" let anyone type their own word in the cover style, which flooded social media with green squares.

head: Date

rows: Charli XCX releases her sixth album, Brat.
Creator Kelley Heyer posts a dance to the track "Apple" on TikTok; Charli, Troye Sivan and celebrities join in.
"Brat summer" and the lime-green cover become a meme template used by brands and fans.
The remix album Brat and It's Completely Different but Also Still Brat comes out.
Collins Dictionary names "brat" its Word of the Year.
Brat wins three Grammys, including Best Dance/Electronic Album.

ul: "Lost my keys, danced on a table, no regrets. It's a brat summer."
"That's so brat" for something bold and unapologetic.
Captions and designs in the green cover style: lowercase words on lime green.
The "Apple" dance: hands on hips, body rolls, holding up an imaginary apple, pretending to drive.

body: Brat summer belongs to 2024, but "brat" stuck as everyday slang and brat green is still instantly recognisable. Charli XCX has said she doesn't get to decide when the era ends.

faq.q: What does it mean to be brat?
faq.a: Being confident, carefree and a little messy without apologising for it. Charli XCX described it as a girl who likes to party and maybe says dumb things sometimes.
A bright, slightly sour lime green taken from the cover of Charli XCX's album Brat.

faq.q: What song is the Brat summer dance?
faq.a: "Apple", a track on Brat. The dance was created by TikTok creator Kelley Heyer in 2024.
